name: constraint equations
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 限定系统几何位置、运动或接触状态关系的方程。
usage_overview: 在轮轨相互作用分析中，用于联系轮轨接触点的位移及其时间导数，将接触处的运动相容关系写入模型，使轮轨双方的运动描述满足相应约束。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the unevenness of rail irregularities at the three-dimensional space is preliminarily considered by taking a hypothesis of normal distribution and accordingly, the wheel–rail three-dimensional constraint equations are presented.

In this work, matrix formulations for coupling the vehicle– track systems are presented, where the mathematical constraint equations for depicting wheel–rail geometric contacts in 3-D space are illustrated, besides, the coupling matrices for vehicle–track interactions are elaborated.
